title.description: The case, as one imperative line. "Design fraud detection", "Design AI-powered product search".

summary.description: What makes this system hard, in one or two short sentences. The tension, not the feature list.

constraints.description: Three scale or latency facts that bound the design, each short enough to sit in a chip. "500M txns/day", "p99 < 200ms end-to-end", "0.05% fraud rate".

openingPrompt.description: The single thing the interviewer says to open the round, out loud, after greeting them. Ends by handing over — asking what the system has to do, not telling them.

deepDiveOptions.description: Three areas worth an eventual deep dive on this case, for the interviewer to pick from later. Not shown to the candidate.
